skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply optimization techniques to solve economic problems with multiple constraints and variables.
Apply linear algebra concepts to solve optimization problems.
Analyze and solve optimization problems using mathematical analysis.
Use programming languages like R to solve optimization problems.
Develop decision-making skills and adapt to external changes.
Design and implement algorithms to solve optimization problems.
Model economic scenarios using optimization techniques.
Enhance critical thinking to solve complex economic problems.
Solve practical economic problems using optimization methods.
Collaborate effectively in group discussions and problem-solving sessions.
